name: Red Sauce
description: A simple tomato-based sauce — rich, aromatic, and perfect for pasta. Quick to make, full of flavour.

name: Lamb Rogan Josh – Restaurant Style
description: Succulent pieces of lamb cooked in a rich, flavourful sauce.

name: Strawberry Meringue Roulade
description: A light and airy meringue roulade filled with whipped cream and fresh strawberries.

name: Satay Sauce
description: Rich, creamy, slightly spicy, and perfect for chicken, beef, lamb, veggies — or eaten straight from the pan when no one's watching.

name: Classic Aussie Sausage Rolls
description: The Aussie snack king — perfect for footy days, picnics, or anytime hunger strikes.

name: Soft Sourdough Cinnamon Rolls
description: Wildly soft, pillowy sourdough cinnamon rolls with gooey centres and bold cinnamon flavour. Made with tangzhong and an overnight rise for exceptional softness.

name: Sticky Date Pudding with Caramel Sauce
description: Microwave marvel — rich, sticky, and surprisingly fast.

name: Homemade Sub Buns
description: Soft, sturdy sandwich rolls perfect for loaded subs, hoagies, or heroes.

name: Soft White Bread (Tangzhong Method)
description: A soft, pale, everyday loaf that stays tender for days without milk, butter, or yellowing — thanks to the tangzhong technique.

name: Soft White Bread 2 (Tangzhong)
description: A soft, airy loaf with a tender crumb, made using tangzhong and hand-rolled sections for perfect pull-apart texture.

name: Sweet Chilli Sauce
description: A Thai-inspired sweet and spicy sauce — sticky, tangy, and addictive. Perfect as a dip or glaze.

name: Better Than Takeaway Sweet & Sour Pork
description: Golden, crispy pork with a sticky, tangy sauce — exactly what you want when you skip the takeaway.

name: Sweet & Sour Sauce – Home Chef Flex
description: Tangy, sweet, and versatile — adjust sweetness, tang, or add heat. Perfect for home cooking and fridge-friendly storage.

name: Sweet & Sour Sauce – Quick Takeout Style
description: Fast, tangy, sweet, and irresistibly familiar — your shortcut to classic Chinese takeout flavour at home.

name: Sweet & Spicy Orange Sauce
description: A zesty Asian-inspired sauce — citrusy, fiery, and utterly moreish. Restaurant quality at home.

name: Taco Seasoning — Old El Paso Style (From Scratch)
description: A homemade taco seasoning that replicates the Old El Paso packet blend — but fresher, deeper, and completely under your control. One batch equals roughly one standard 35 g packet.

name: Tangzhong Grain & Seed Bread
description: A soft, generous loaf with the soul of old-world baking — built on modern tangzhong and a hearty, soaked grain-and-seed mix that gives depth without stealing moisture.

name: Teriyaki Marinade
description: A sweet-savoury marinade that makes chicken tender, juicy, and full of flavour. Perfect for grilling, baking, or stir-frying.

name: Teriyaki Sauce
description: A classic Japanese glaze — sweet, umami-rich, and beautifully glossy. Authentic taste, simple method.

name: The Ultimate Chocolate Mud Cake
description: A decadent, dense, and fudgy masterpiece topped with silky chocolate ganache — the ultimate indulgence.

name: Chef-Style Tiramisu Gateau
description: Luscious layers. Boozy brilliance. A dessert that whispers Italian and screams, "I'm extra."

name: Tomato and Olive Flan
description: A savoury baked flan filled with tomatoes, olives, basil, and Gruyère cheese.

name: Traditional Turkish Bread
description: Soft, slightly chewy, and baked to a golden finish with a traditional sesame and nigella seed topping.

name: Vindaloo Paste
description: A bold, tangy, fire-forward paste — the beating heart of a proper vindaloo.

name: White Sauce (Béchamel)
description: A classic French white sauce — smooth, creamy, and versatile. The foundation of countless dishes.

name: Traditional ANZAC Biscuits
description: A classic Australian favourite — golden, chewy, and steeped in history. This version uses a higher oat-to-coconut ratio for better binding and a less greasy dough. Weigh each ball to 35g for consistent results every time.

name: Ana's Chia Vanilla Pudding
description: A creamy, no-cook pudding that finally puts chia seeds to good use. Sweetened with honey and scented with vanilla — the redemption arc after the ANZAC disaster.

name: Alfredo Sauce
description: Rich, velvety, and unapologetically indulgent. A classic cream-based Alfredo that coats pasta like silk and demands to be eaten immediately.

name: Apple & Cinnamon Scrolls
description: Golden, fragrant, and guaranteed to vanish fast. Best enjoyed warm and unapologetically drowned in icing.

name: Apple Pie
description: The kind of pie that disappears faster than good intentions — crisp pastry, soft spiced apples, and zero leftovers.

name: Apple Strudel
description: Easy apple strudel recipe using store-bought puff pastry and staples like apples, walnuts, and cinnamon. Perfect for dessert or a sweet breakfast treat!

name: Arrabbiata Sauce
description: A fiery Italian tomato sauce — bold, spicy, and full of passion. Not for the faint-hearted.

name: Apricot Chicken
description: Classic retro apricot chicken — sticky, sweet, savoury, and impossibly easy. Chicken thigh fillets baked in a glossy apricot glaze.

name: Baked Cheesecake
description: A classic baked cheesecake with a creamy, dense filling and crisp biscuit base. Rich, smooth, and far more forgiving than its reputation suggests.

name: Banana Bread
description: Like Nan used to make — moist, forgiving, and quietly better than it has any right to be.

name: 20 Minute Beef Stock Pot
description: A fast, deeply flavoured beef stock base — perfect for rich stews, braises, and hearty sauces.

name: Beef & Mushroom Stroganoff
description: Rich, creamy, and anchored by mushrooms — a classic dinner that works for weeknights or company.

name: Beef Vindaloo
description: An authentic, fiery, melt-in-your-mouth beef curry that doesn't muck around.

name: Brandy Mustard Steak
description: Scotch filet in a brandy and mustard cream sauce. Bold, warming, and exactly the kind of dish a 1990s bistro did best.

name: Carpet Bag Steak
description: Scotch fillet stuffed with fresh oysters and Camembert cheese, finished with a red wine and demi glace sauce. The most theatrical dish on the menu.

name: Chicken Kiev
description: Golden crumbed chicken breast stuffed with garlic butter, served with a simple tomato cream sauce. A showstopper from the bistro era.

name: Chicken Papion
description: Pan-fried chicken breast with fresh oysters folded into a cream sauce. Unusual, elegant, and utterly of its era.

name: Chicken Picante
description: Breast chicken in a cream sauce punched up with Dijon mustard and green peppercorns. Sharp, creamy, and satisfying.

name: Chicken Riverina
description: Chicken breast stuffed with dried apricots and almonds, finished with a cream and apricot sauce. Named for the Riverina region of New South Wales.

name: Demi-Glace
description: Deep, rich, concentrated beef sauce. Makes about 2-3 litres.

name: Filet Mignon
description: Scotch fillet wrapped in bacon with a mushroom and demi glace cream sauce. Simple, rich, and timeless.

name: Fish of the Day
description: Grilled fresh fish fillet with a light lemon and white wine cream sauce. Simply done and always changing.

name: Lamb Cutlets
description: Crumbed lamb cutlets with crispy bacon and a rich demi glace gravy. Honest bistro comfort food.

name: Mediterranean Steak
description: Scotch fillet in a rich cream sauce with king prawns and green peppercorns. Surf and turf done properly — the bistro way.

name: Orange Thai Chicken
description: The Thai Chicken's sibling — same ginger and chilli base but brightened with fresh orange juice for a citrus-forward cream sauce.

name: Pavlova
description: Crisp-shelled meringue with a soft marshmallow centre, topped with whipped cream and fresh seasonal fruit. An Australian icon.

name: Profiteroles
description: Light choux pastry puffs filled with whipped cream and drizzled with warm chocolate ganache. Served with fresh fruit.

name: Rack of Lamb
description: French-trimmed rack of lamb oven-roasted and served with a spiced plum and demi glace sauce.

name: Reef and Beef
description: Scotch fillet topped with a generous seafood Mornay sauce. The ultimate bistro surf and turf.

name: Thai Chicken
description: Breast chicken in a ginger, chilli and cream sauce. Warmth without the fire — a nod to Thai flavours in a classic bistro setting.

name: Veal Mozzarella
description: Veal wrapped with mushroom, bacon, and shallots in puff pastry, topped with melted mozzarella. A Wellington-style preparation from the bistro kitchen.

name: Veal Oscar
description: Crumbed and deep-fried veal topped with blanched asparagus, seafood Mornay, and melted cheese — finished under the grill. A classic fine dining preparation.

name: Veal Scaloppine
description: Thin pan-fried veal with a creamy onion and mushroom sauce. Quick, simple, and deeply satisfying.

name: Heavenly Blueberry Muffins
description: Light, fluffy muffins crowned with a crisp crumble and bursting with juicy blueberries — built for quiet mornings and empty plates.

name: Original Bulalo
description: A rich, clear Filipino beef bone marrow soup from Batangas. Beef shanks are slow-boiled for hours until fall-off-the-bone tender, paired with corn, cabbage, and bok choy in a deeply flavourful broth.

name: Restaurant-Style Butter Chicken
description: A rich, silky, full-flavoured classic — ready in just 40 minutes.

name: Cherry and Coconut Cake
description: A wonderful buttery, soft pound cake bursting with cherries in every bite! The flavour is out of this world, rich in coconut. Bake in a bundt pan or loaf pan.

name: Chicken Cacciatore
description: A hearty Italian classic — tender chicken simmered in a rich tomato and olive sauce, perfect over jasmine rice.

name: Chicken Pineapple
description: A sweet and slightly spicy dish that deserves complimenting.

name: Chicken, Mushroom & Bacon Pies
description: Golden, flaky, and stuffed with comfort — a proper home-baked classic where pub fare meets homemade love.

name: Chicken Shawarma
description: Quick stovetop Middle Eastern chicken, marinated with authentic spices and seared hot for charred, tender strips.

name: Chicken Teriyaki
description: Juicy, tender chicken marinated in a sweet-savoury teriyaki sauce — quick stovetop method for weeknights.

name: Chilli Garlic Oil
description: A fragrant Asian condiment — fiery, aromatic, and incredibly versatile. Elevates everything it touches.

name: Chocolate Muffins with Ganache
description: Tall domes like bakery royalty, fluffy like a hymn, dipped in butter-rich ganache — decadent perfection.

name: Chocolate Mousse
description: The essence of a mousse is lightness, indicated by its French name meaning foam or froth. This favourite is delicate yet rich with cream and chocolate.

name: Chocolate Rum Balls
description: Quick, fun, and dangerously delicious — the ultimate no-bake chocolate treat.

name: Choux Pastry (Profiteroles)
description: Light, crisp, and ready to cradle cream — the classic French pastry that never goes out of style.

name: Bakery-Style Cinnamon Buns
description: Soft, pillowy, buttery, and swirled with cinnamon sugar — just like your favourite bakery.

name: Cinnamon Twists
description: A soft, buttery treat with a swirl of spiced sweetness — perfect for breakfast or afternoon tea.

name: Classic Carrot Cake
description: A hearty old-fashioned carrot cake — dense, moist, deeply spiced, and sturdy enough to slice for days without apology.

name: Crème Caramel
description: A French classic — silky custard topped with a thin layer of amber caramel. Made possible with the LG Kitchen collection.

name: Crepes with Maple Syrup & Butter
description: Golden, versatile crepes perfect for sweet or savoury cravings. Serve warm — simple is best.

name: Curry Chicken with Coconut Cream
description: Tender chicken in a rich, creamy coconut curry sauce. Simple, comforting, and packed with flavour.

name: Dark Rye Bread
description: Full credit to bakers who perfected this rich, flavourful loaf — dense, dark, and deeply satisfying.

name: Double Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Because plain chocolate is for lightweights. Soft, fudgy, and packed with chocolate chips — perfect with a cold glass of milk.

name: Filipino Pork Toccino
description: Sweet, caramelised pork — juicy, tender, and perfect for a classic Filipino breakfast or dinner.

name: Pancit (Filipino Stir-Fried Noodles)
description: A vibrant, savoury noodle dish with pork, chicken, and crisp vegetables — classic Filipino comfort food.

name: High-Hydration Focaccia
description: A gloriously wet, no-knead focaccia with an open, airy crumb and crisp golden crust.

name: Focaccia
description: A classic Italian flatbread studded with olives and rosemary, baked until golden and crisp.

name: Orange & Poppyseed Friands
description: Fluffy little citrus pillows that taste like sunshine — and maybe just a bit of smug satisfaction.

name: Garlic Butter Crusty Bread
description: Soft, golden bread with a crispy crust and a rich garlic butter topping — perfect for any meal.

name: Hamburger Buns
description: Soft, golden, and pillowy — the perfect base for your ultimate burger creations.

name: Airy High-Hydration Ciabatta
description: Soft, open-crumb Italian bread using a liquid-dough method. Big holes, crisp crust, zero nonsense.

name: Honey Garlic Sauce
description: A sweet and savoury Asian glaze — sticky, garlicky, and impossible to resist. A family favourite.

name: Wendy's-Style Hot Dog Buns
description: Soft, golden buns made for loading up with your favourite hot dogs — eight generously sised rolls.

name: Honey Soy Chicken
description: Chicken thigh fillets marinated in honey, soy, garlic, and ginger. Pan-fried until sticky and caramelised. Serve with rice and vegetables.

name: Hummingbird — Cafe Style
description: A lush, old-fashioned Southern classic — moist, fragrant, packed with fruit, and crowned with cream cheese frosting.

name: Classic Lasagne — Ragù & Béchamel
description: A traditional layered lasagne that warms the ribs and calms the spirit.

name: Homemade Korma Paste
description: A rich, fragrant paste — the foundation for a proper korma curry.

name: Marinara Sauce
description: A traditional Italian tomato sauce — fresh, herby, and full of character. Simple ingredients, perfect taste.

name: Lemon Meringue Pie
description: A classic tart with buttery pastry, tangy lemon filling, and light fluffy meringue topping.

name: Classic Aussie Meat Pies
description: True blue, unapologetically hearty, and as Australian as a sunburn at Christmas.

name: Mongolian Beef Stir-Fry
description: Serve this sizzling stir-fry in a cast-iron pan for full restaurant-style drama — the sizzling, spitting finish brings the flavour alive.

name: Veal Cordon Bleu
description: Thin veal escalopes wrapped around smoked ham and Swiss cheese, crumbed and deep-fried to golden perfection. Served with a Dijon cream sauce.

name: Mornay / Cheese Sauce
description: A smooth, creamy cheese sauce made the right way — starting with a proper roux, then béchamel, then cheese.

name: Mongolian Stir-Fry Sauce
description: A rich, sticky, savoury-sweet sauce perfect with beef, chicken, or vegetables.

name: Apricot Flan
description: Not just dessert — this is the one that makes the room go quiet. Soft custard, buttery pastry, and apricots that know their job.

name: Basic Muffin Mix
description: A simple, dependable base recipe — sweet or savoury, load it up any way you like.

name: Mushrooms with Herb Nut Butter
description: Baked mushroom caps filled with a rich herb and almond butter, finished until golden and fragrant.

name: Seasoned Beef Mince — Nachos & Tacos
description: The foundation of great nachos and tacos — a rich, deeply seasoned beef mince that holds its own under cheese, sour cream, and all the toppings.

name: Mongolian Lamb
description: A sweet and savoury stir-fry with tender lamb, Chinese Five Spice, and Hoisin — even better than many restaurant versions.

name: Pancakes for Two
description: Light, fluffy pancakes made from scratch — perfect for a weekend breakfast. Simple ingredients, no electric mixer needed.

name: Orange & Poppy Seed Cake
description: A bright, citrusy favourite — buttery, fragrant, and layered with a lush orange cream.

name: Pancit Canton
description: The chewy, savoury-sweet egg noodle version of Filipino Pancit. Richer than Bihon thanks to oyster sauce and Chinese sausage, with a satisfying bite from thick wheat noodles.

name: Pesto Sauce
description: A vibrant Italian basil sauce — fresh, aromatic, and utterly delicious. Pure summer in a bowl.

name: Pancit Bihon
description: The light, thin rice noodle version most people associate with Filipino Pancit. A birthday table staple symbolising long life, best served with a squeeze of calamansi.

name: Ultimate Homemade Pizza Dough
description: A versatile dough that works beautifully for both pizza bases and bread rolls. Simple ingredients, minimal fuss, and results that are worth every minute of the knead.

name: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
description: Sticky, caramelised pineapple upside-down cake. Built from pantry staples, baked in a water tray for a moist, even crumb, flipped warm, and it didn't stick. Looks awesome. Tastes even better.

name: Plain Cheesecake (Classic No Bake)
description: No-bake simplicity at its finest — smooth, sweet, and forever dependable. A real fridge-set classic.

name: Potato Gnocchi with Tomato Sauce
description: Soft potato gnocchi served with a simple tomato and basil sauce.

name: Rough Puff Pastry
description: A smart compromise between traditional puff pastry and store-bought. Quick to make with excellent rise and flakiness — the perfect everyday laminated dough. Keep everything cold and don't overwork it.

name: Chocolate Mug Cake
description: A single-serve chocolate cake made in a mug, ready in under 2 minutes. Perfect for late-night cravings.

name: Traditional Puff Pastry
description: The full classic method with butter block and multiple turns. Ultimate rise, ethereal flakiness, and deep satisfaction. A project worth the effort — make this when pastry is the centrepiece and you have a Sunday afternoon.

name: Lamb Korma
description: A rich, fragrant lamb curry in a silky yoghurt-based sauce — deeply spiced and full of flavour.

name: Steak Boston
description: Scotch fillet coated in Creole spice and served with a red wine butter sauce. Bold, spiced, and full of character.

name: Lamb Vindaloo
description: Succulent lamb cooked low and slow in a classic, fiery vindaloo sauce.

name: Classic Lamingtons
description: Aussie pride in a cake cube — built properly, with a real sponge that can hold its own.

name: Lemon Coconut Cake
description: A simple old-school favourite — bright lemon, soft crumb, and that warm coconut finish.

name: Pork Caldereta
description: A rich Filipino stew known for its tender meat and savoury, slightly spicy tomato-based sauce thickened with liver spread.

name: Veal Madagascar
description: Veal in a rich cream and demi glace sauce with bacon, capsicum, tomato, onion, garlic, and green peppercorns. Served hot or mild — the customer's choice.

name: Banana Cake with Lemon Frosting
description: A moist, tender banana cake made with oil — no mixer required. Crowned with a tangy lemon buttercream and toasted coconut.
